status: PROVISIONAL PARAMETRIC STUDY - not a frozen stack; values are planning inputs with explicit class/source
coordinates: Front view: north=-Y, east=+X; MAIN origin (100,100); Z positive from front exterior toward wrist.

conventions.T_total: front-most exterior surface to the outer skin-contact surface of the optical window/pod
conventions.T_body: front-most exterior surface to the caseback outer plane, excluding pod protrusion (T_total - h_pod)
conventions.target_applies_to: T_total (owner decision 2026-10-10: exterior display-glass surface to deepest normal wrist-facing pod surface). T_body and h_pod are tracked separately; the target must not be forced if the parametric stack shows it infeasible.

corners.thick: every parameter at max (worst-case stack, conservative linear sum)

conventions.rss_note: Also report an RSS stack: nom sum + sqrt(sum((max-nom)^2)) for parameters with max>nom; RSS is informational only.

t_front_extra.source: Owner decision open: display cover glass used as exterior (0) vs added sapphire/bezel lip (up to ~0.5).

t_display.source: ZC-A1D43W-046 spec V1.0 p4 (43.9x43.9x2.05) and p5 (2.05 +/-0.1, includes integral cover glass).

c_front.source: Clearance between tallest F.Cu body and display rear (incl. display rear foam/tape tolerance).

t_display_fpc_fold.source: ZC-A1D43W-046 p5 rear view: folded FPC + steel stiffener T0.15 / PI stiffener T0.2 + tape T0.05; local folded-envelope drawing not supplied; footprint up to 0.7 MAX beyond outline.

h_j1_mated.source: OCN OK-23GF/GM-04 drawing: mating height 0.8 mm.

h_shield_can.source: Phase-1 provisional shield concept (two-piece can ~0.85 total); no shield MPN.

t_main.source: MAIN .kicad_pcb thickness 0.8 (stackup sum 0.768); +/-10% fabricator tolerance assumed (PARAMETRIC part).

c_back.source: Clearance B.Cu body to carrier pocket floor/film.

t_carrier_web.source: Battery carrier/midplate web; molded plastic >=0.4 typical; sheet metal option thinner but conductive (insulation/RF impact).

t_insulator.source: PI/Kapton or PET film between pouch and any exposed board/pocket.

t_pack_nom.source: LPR454440 catalog nominal thickness 4.5 mm (cell model code).

tol_pack_thick.source: Finished protected-pack thickness tolerance incl. tape/insulation/PCM fold; no supplier drawing.

g_axial.source: Swelling/growth allowance; planning ~5-10% of 4.5 mm; supplier must state permitted growth and restraint.

c_axial.source: Assembly clearance / compliant foam above pack.

t_lower_web.source: Carrier floor between pack and REAR module/FPC under-run; includes PI film.

h_rear_inner.source: REAR battery-facing component height: 0 if single-sided (all parts on optical face), up to ~0.75 if AFEs/muxes/MAX30208-side parts go on inner face. Strategy is a study variable.

c_rear_inner.source: Clearance REAR inner-face parts to carrier floor (applies only if h_rear_inner > 0).

t_rear_pcb.source: REAR rigid board thickness; 4-layer study start (0.6-1.0). Current staging file 1.6/2-layer is a placeholder only.

h_optics_max.source: SFH7018A/SFH2703 0.6 +/-0.1; MAX30208 0.75; SFH4053B and MAX86141 seated height still SUPPLIER_DATA_REQUIRED (assumed <= MAX30208).

c_optics.source: Component top to window inner face / optical spacer.

h_pod.source: Pod protrusion beyond caseback plane; explicitly NOT freezable from current evidence (requires wrist/strap trials). Sweep values: 0.0, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.5.

rules.front_gap: max(H_F_under_display + c_front, h_shield_can + c_front, h_j1_mated). H_F_under_display = max seated F.Cu height (package max + solder_allowance for PARAMETRIC parts) of MAIN footprints whose centre lies within r <= 21.95 mm (display outline radius 43.9/2) - the display is a rigid flat module, so its rear plane must clear the tallest part anywhere beneath it. Also report the governing reference designator and the second-tallest value with its reference.
rules.back_zone: max(t_carrier_web, H_B_in_battery + c_back) + t_insulator. H_B_in_battery = max seated B.Cu height of MAIN footprints whose centre lies within r <= 22.0 mm (battery nominal projection).

radial.note: Radial budget at the south FPC station and generally. All radii from watch centre (MAIN origin). Case values are provisional targets.

t_case_wall.source: Side wall incl. draft; button bores/antenna windows need more locally.

tol_pack_dia.source: Finished-pack diameter tolerance incl. tape/edge seal; PCM/tab lobe modelled separately.

c_radial.source: Architecture-review proposed allowance per side beyond max finished pack (not a supplier value).

t_carrier_wall.source: Carrier side wall between pack and FPC channel (edge protection).

t_fpc.source: 2-layer polyimide FPC with coverlays (0.1-0.15); shield film adds ~0.02-0.05.

R_bend_min.source: Static bend-to-install inner radius; IPC-2223 guidance ~6x (1-layer) to ~12x (2-layer) thickness; fabricator must confirm.

R_main.source: MAIN development envelope Edge.Cuts circle r=23.0 (NOT final outline).

checks.margin_straight_run: R_case_inner - R_channel_outer_straight  (vertical FPC run beside the pack)
checks.R_edge_wrap_outer: R_main + max(R_bend_min, t_main/2) + t_fpc + c_fpc  (180-degree wrap of an FPC from a MAIN F.Cu connector around the MAIN edge)
checks.margin_main_to_case: R_case_inner - R_main  (bare MAIN edge clearance, before any FPC)

radial.corner_rule: Evaluate margins at nominal, at a conservative corner (D_case_outer at min and t_case_wall at max, i.e. smallest R_case_inner; all other terms at max), and at an optimistic corner (D_case_outer at max, t_case_wall at min; all other terms at min). Report each with its governing terms.

stations.desc: Core under U101/U901 and storage B.Cu cavity
Charger contact module, rear east ~3 o'clock
